{{Quote|What's taking him?''"<br />(From box): "''Thump. Thump. WHAMthumprattlerattle.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] awaits the result of a Contort/Escape attempt|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Contort/Escape''' was a Control-based [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] to escape from [[Binders/Legends|binders]] and other restraints by contorting the body in physically possible but painful ways, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Control Pain|suppress the painful effects]] of the procedure. One example was to dislocate both the thumb and pinky finger to reduce the width of a hand to slip out of binders; a trained [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could use the Force to withstand the pain and negate damage to muscles and ligaments.<ref name="RPG" />
